dashboard.label: Blue Team Evidence Validation
dashboard.description: Synthetic replay. Authentication and endpoint correlation validation.

search.query: search index=blue_team validation_run="1794686230163894920" earliest=0 latest=now | fields _raw _time sourcetype | fields - host | spath | search sourcetype="bt:auth" logon_type=10 (event_id=4624 OR event_id=4625) | eval _time=strptime(timestamp,"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"), record_id=tonumber(record_id), event_id=tonumber(event_id) | eval computer=lower(computer), domain=lower(domain), user=lower(user) | dedup computer record_id | where src_ip!="" AND src_ip!="-" | sort 0 +_time +record_id | streamstats current=f count(eval(event_id=4624)) as previous_successes by computer domain user src_ip | fillnull value=0 previous_successes | streamstats time_window=10m count(eval(event_id=4625)) as failures by computer domain user src_ip previous_successes | where event_id=4624 AND failures>=5 | table computer domain user src_ip record_id failures

search index=blue_team validation_run="1794686230163894920" earliest=0 latest=now | fields _raw _time sourcetype | fields - host | spath | search sourcetype="bt:endpoint" | eval event_time=strptime(timestamp,"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ") | eventstats min(eval(if(kind="logon",event_time,null()))) as logon_start by host session | where event_time>=logon_start AND event_time<=logon_start+900 | eval encoded=if(kind="process" AND match(command_line,"(?i)(^|\s)-(enc|encodedcommand)(\s|$)"),1,0) | eventstats min(eval(if(encoded=1,event_time,null()))) as process_start by host session process_guid | eval valid_network=if(kind="network" AND event_time>=process_start,1,0) | eventstats values(eval(if(valid_network=1,id,null()))) as network_evidence by host session | eventstats values(eval(if(kind="logon",security_record,null()))) as successful_record by host session | where encoded=1 AND isnotnull(network_evidence) AND isnotnull(successful_record) | table id host session successful_record network_evidence
